title: Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees Registration Terms: Participations per Student, Activity and Season
content:
**Registration terms of Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees.** A household may register any number of its students; there is no limit per household. Each participation covers one student in one activity for one season of one school year.

**Clause 1 (one open participation per activity and season).** A registration is accepted only when the student has no other participation in the same activity for the same season and school year in status registered, cleared or academically ineligible. At most 1 such open participation exists per student, activity, season and school year.

**Clause 2 (season limit per activity type).** A student may hold participations in different activities, up to the activity type's most participations per season: the count is of the student's other participations of the same activity type for that season and school year in status registered, cleared or academically ineligible.

## How Clause 1 is judged

- **Authority.** The test is made on the district's participation records, not on the family's account of them.
- **Same object.** A participation blocks the registration only if all four match: the same student, the same activity, the same season and the same school year.
- **Statuses that block.** Registered, cleared and academically ineligible. A participation of that student, activity, season and year in any other status (withdrawn, cut or completed) is not one of the participations Clause 1 names, so it does not stand in the way.

| Existing participation of the student | Same activity, season and year? | Status | Registration under Clause 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| choir, fall, the school year registered | yes | cleared | not accepted |
| choir, fall, the school year registered | yes | withdrawn | accepted |
| choir, winter, the same school year | no (other season) | registered | accepted |
| band, fall, the same school year | no (other activity) | cleared | accepted, subject to Clause 2 |

*(The rows are hypothetical illustrations of the clause.)*

## Clause 2 illustrated (hypothetical)

Under Campus Club Membership, with a season limit of 4, a student already holding 3 club participations for the fall season in a listed status may register a fourth club for that fall; with 4 already held, a fifth is beyond the limit.
